purpose: Require identity-bearing section hierarchy to be modeled in host geometry rather than approximated by one generic shell plus trim.
automotive_checks: hood centre is distinguishable from fender crown in height/flow
front fender crown resolves around wheel opening and lamp aperture
rear quarter/haunch carries the reference rear-biased mass
greenhouse length and A/C pillar bases match independent visual targets
rocker/lower side taper does not remain a rectangular slab
surface hierarchy is visible under clay/reflection lighting without trim
forbidden: single generic upper body section used for hood fender and rear quarter when reference separates them
trim or lamps used to create apparent section changes that host geometry lacks
micro-detail refinement while section hierarchy is rejected
